training_plan.purpose: Engineering and compute feasibility pilot, not a converged policy or final research comparison
training_plan.action: 11 active channels: arm 7, gripper 1, torso 1, base 2; stationary head expanded as two zeros
training_plan.observation: Native HAB state + previous/current returned force /100, cumulative contact /5000, elapsed fraction; state SAC uses identical input
training_plan.training_budget_rule: Complete pilot, measure wall time and memory; no extrapolation from PushCube throughput
training_plan.risk_stage_gate: Do not train or claim a risk-aware planner until a task-solving world-model baseline and matched-observation SAC are established. Pilot alone is not a research benchmark.

tdmpc2.basis: Derived from unchanged, hash-audited custom entrypoint and completed episode/update logs; raw upstream initialization YAML is preserved.

unused_upstream_trainer_defaults.explanation: These fields are not used to construct HABState or schedule the custom training loop. They are not actual task/budget/seed values.
